product_desc: A 14-inch thin and light notebook featuring an 8th Gen Intel Core processor, Intel UHD Graphics 620, and a Full HD IPS display.

product_features.Memory: Up to 16 GB of DDR4 RAM.
product_features.Storage: Up to 512GB SSD or up to 256 GB SSD or PCIe/NVMe Up to 512 GB storage.
product_features.Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 or NVIDIA GeForce MX150.
product_features.Ports: 1x USB 3.0 with PowerShare, 1x USB 3.1 Gen 1, 1x USB 2.0, 1x HDMI 1.4a, 1x headset (headphone and microphone combo) port, SD card reader.
product_features.Special Features: Brushed aluminum and magnesium alloy construction, ultrathin bezel, diamond-cut edges.
